From c41a9abd6ae31d130e8f332e7c8800c4c866234b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 20:11:15 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mt76: mt7925: Fix possible oob access in
 mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211()

Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields in
mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211 in order to avoid a possible oob access.

Fixes: c948b5da6bbec ("wifi: mt76: mt7925: add Mediatek Wi-Fi7 driver for mt7925 chips")
Signed-off-by: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260226-mt76-addba-req-oob-access-v1-2-b0f6d1ad4850@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c
index 871b67101976..0d9435900423 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c
@@ -668,6 +668,7 @@ mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211(struct mt76_dev *dev, __le32 *txwi,
 	u32 val;
 
 	if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
+	    skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ)
 		tid = MT_TX_ADDBA;
-- 
2.34.1

The patch addresses an out-of-bounds (OOB) access vulnerability in the `mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211()` function of the mt76 driver.

**Modifications:**

- **File:** `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c`
  - Added a length check (`skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 &&`) before accessing the management frame fields (`mgmt->u.action.category`, `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code`) when handling an action frame (IEEE 802.11).
  - This new condition ensures the SKB (socket buffer) contains at least the minimum required action frame header plus one byte for the category code before dereferencing pointers to management frame structures.

**Relationship:**  
The single modification is a safety guard placed between the existing `ieee80211_is_action(fc)` check and the subsequent access to `mgmt` fields. By verifying the frame length first, it prevents the driver from reading beyond the allocated buffer when processing malformed or short frames, thus avoiding an OOB access. The fix is directly tied to the bug described in the commit message (fixes commit c948b5da6bbec).

    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
